_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. `s.fem.fem3d` is a semio-NATIVE structural MODEL — nine id-keyed collections and one settings record — and its vocabulary edits the model, never the analysis, so a finite-element solver has nothing to adjudicate. The reference is a SECOND IMPLEMENTATION in Python written from this subset's committed snapshot schema, mutation grammar and specification vectors.

oracles.rationale: A second implementation of the `s.fem.fem3d` model and all twenty-five typed mutations, in Python, at `../../../../../🧪️tests/mutate-fem3d-1/🐍️component.py`. Written from `../🧬️schema/📸️snapshot/🔣️component.json`, `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/📝️text/📖️component.grammar.semio` and the twenty-five committed `(before, mutation, after, outcome)` specification vectors — which is also where the RECORD shapes and the cascade rules are actually written down, including the one only they state: an element is a `frame` carrying a `roll` about its own axis OR a `bar` carrying none. It imports nothing from this repository and transliterates none of its Rust. A third-party library was declined, not merely absent: `code_aster`, `OpenSees`, `anastruct` and `PyNite` compute displacements and forces FROM a model, while every one of the twenty-five kinds edits the model document itself, and none of them reads `.dsl.semio`. DEFECT FOUND WHILE WRITING IT, reported rather than worked around and identical to the `◻2d` sibling's: `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/🔣️component.json` is a verbatim copy of the SNAPSHOT schema with the title changed, and in the snapshot schema every record `$def` is an EMPTY object with no properties. `package` is deliberately empty: the implementation needs no distribution, so this entry contributes nothing to `🔒️dependencies.json`.
